00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000028.title: Where the bell tower went
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000028.synopsis: The tower was on the east spit. It is on the west. It rings when a place moves, and Father Quill swears he rings it.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000028.notes: The comic mystery that turns out to be the same mystery as the serious one.
